segments.raw_interview_anchor: Mostly time and track record. That pattern's fired dozens of rounds in similar ground without a hiccup, so redesigning burden and spacing for a fault trace that geology themselves called minor felt like it would cost us a day we didn't have.

segments.speaker: Participant

segments.speaker: Participant

segments.speaker: Participant

segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a data-based explanation for why the timing decision felt resolved and contains no hidden bias instance.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: It reminded me a lot of a panel I worked years ago at a different site — same kind of localized fault, same overbreak signature. There, the fix was tightening the pattern and adjusting timing specifically through that corridor, and it worked well. So that's what I recommended here.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant attributes the outcome to a remembered prior-mine pattern and recommends its fix without first incorporating current instrumentation.
